build: 通用浏览器兼容-实现验收
validationNote: 正式发布文件统一为0.4.3-compat.5，并给入口、CSS与内部模块引用加版本参数后，已重新通过34项单元、22项Chrome通用、10项滚动、10项Chrome安全与10项桌面WebKit安全检查。桌面引擎与合成助手结果不能代替iPhone真机验证。

cases.name: 模型复现助手强引用残留及目标回收
清理事件批量创建前端后，队列复用已有iframe
助手DOM替换监听已生效，正常窗口移动不重复替换楼层
modern API：5层上下阅读和关闭恢复
legacy API：5层上下阅读和关闭恢复
设置10层：10个前端全部完成
单次跨上下巨大占位后停手：非空视口且10层恢复
慢前端和快速反向：旧任务不滞留
12000px末楼不会错误拉动历史窗口
异步回收期间继续滑动：最终手势接管位置
历史阅读时追加消息：区间和重叠实例保留
相邻窗口复用重叠iframe
120轮跨历史滚动：后台最多11个实例，无脱离DOM引用
恢复时切换聊天：无旧前端污染
底部追加：最近10层继续移动
单个恢复失败后继续其他楼层
挂载异常后暂停并保留末楼，不批量恢复
旧开关不自动继承，重复加载保护
扩展卸载与重新加载
未知助手版本拒绝启动，避免半成品回收
同步查找旧楼层时移动完整窗口
挂起恢复取消后仍有超时守护，不启动第二个恢复调用
No scroll write for a resize below the reader
Continuous scrolling cannot starve visible frontend recovery
Slow helper cleanup keeps the overlapping row stationary
Native scroll anchoring is disabled only while the window is enabled
Long hidden source does not become a giant blank row
Small upward wheel gestures keep making progress
Changing 10 to 15 to 5 floors preserves the reader without reload
One activation adapts both helper settings and closing restores them
Interrupted shutdown waits for explicit restoration without an automatic reload
Missing randomUUID and changing capacity while closed require no reload
blocked browser storage keeps initialization usable and does not orphan helper backups
extension unload restores ordinary rows with a suspended frontend and already compatible helper
extension unload restores ordinary rows with a suspended frontend and adapted helper
hidden page pauses pending work and resumes the requested reading position
diagnostic data omits chat, credentials and page URL, including display output
manual reload is blocked during generation and works after it finishes
mount failure pauses without automatic restoration or navigation
15-second stall preserves page and already compatible helper settings
background time does not consume an active frontend timeout or cause a second call
15-second stall preserves page and adapted helper settings
